name: BLEACHING
source:
A prison cell in the big castle. A young girl is imprisoned in the small cell and humiliated by monsters.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ029259.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一座大城堡的监牢里，一名少女被关在狭小的牢房中，遭到怪物的羞辱。

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ029259.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英文版[/url]]
